The modern stage G characters, which include many characters used for stage A-F orthographies, are included in the Bamum block.

Mro.title: Mro (Unicode block)
Mro.extract: Mro is a Unicode block containing characters for writing the Mru language.

Tangsa.title: Tangsa (Unicode block)
Tangsa.extract: Tangsa is a Unicode block containing characters of the alphabet designed by Mr. Lakhum Mossang for writing the Tangsa language of India and Myanmar.

Bassa Vah.title: Bassa Vah (Unicode block)
Bassa Vah.extract: Bassa Vah is a Unicode block containing characters of the Bassa Vah alphabet which were historically used for writing the Bassa language of Liberia and Sierra Leone.

Pahawh Hmong.title: Pahawh Hmong (Unicode block)
Pahawh Hmong.description: Unicode for writing West Hmongic languages
Pahawh Hmong.extract: Pahawh Hmong is a Unicode block containing characters for writing two West Hmongic languages, Hmong Daw (Hmoob Dawb/White Miao) and Hmong Njua (aka. Mong Leng, Moob Leeg/Green Miao), with the Pahawh Hmong script.

Kirat Rai.title: Kirat Rai (Unicode block)
Kirat Rai.extract: Kirat Rai is a Unicode block containing characters used to write the Bantawa language in the Indian state of Sikkim.

Medefaidrin.title: Medefaidrin (Unicode block)
Medefaidrin.extract: Medefaidrin is a Unicode block containing characters for the constructed script Medefaidrin which is used to write the constructed language of the same name. The Medefaidrin language and script were created as a Christian sacred language by an Ibibio congregation in 1930s Nigeria.

Beria Erfe.title: Beria Erfe (Unicode block)
Beria Erfe.extract: Beria Erfe is a Unicode block containing letters for Zaghawa script, developed as a way to write the Zaghawa language (also known as Beria) of Sudan, Chad, and Libya.

Miao.title: Miao (Unicode block)
Miao.extract: Miao is a Unicode block containing characters of the Pollard script, used for writing the Hmong Daw and A-Hmao languages.

Ideographic Symbols and Punctuation.title: Ideographic Symbols and Punctuation
Ideographic Symbols and Punctuation.extract: Ideographic Symbols and Punctuation is a Unicode block containing symbols and punctuation marks used by ideographic scripts such as Tangut and Nüshu, in addition to punctuation marks, symbols, diacritics and modifier letters supplementing those in the CJK Symbols and Punctuation block.

Tangut.title: Tangut (Unicode block)
Tangut.extract: Tangut is a Unicode block containing characters from the Tangut script, which was used for writing the Tangut language spoken by the Tangut people in the Western Xia Empire, and in China during the Yuan dynasty and early Ming dynasty.

Tangut Components.title: Tangut Components
Tangut Components.extract: Tangut Components is a Unicode block containing components and radicals used in the modern study of the Tangut script.

Khitan Small Script.title: Khitan Small Script (Unicode block)
Khitan Small Script.extract: Khitan Small Script is a Unicode block containing characters from the Khitan small script, which was used for writing the Khitan language spoken by the Khitan people in northern China during the Liao dynasty.

Tangut Supplement.title: Tangut Supplement
Tangut Supplement.extract: Tangut Supplement is a Unicode block containing characters from the Tangut script, which was used for writing the Tangut language spoken by the Tangut people in the Western Xia Empire, and in China during the Yuan dynasty and early Ming dynasty. This block is a supplement to the main Tangut block.

Tangut Components Supplement.title: Tangut Components Supplement
Tangut Components Supplement.extract: Tangut Components Supplement is a Unicode block containing additional components used in the study of the Tangut script. It is a supplement to the main Tangut Components block.

Jurchen.title: Jurchen (Unicode block)
Jurchen.extract: Jurchen is a Unicode block containing Jurchen script characters for the historic Jurchen language.

Jurchen Radicals.title: Jurchen Radicals
Jurchen Radicals.extract: Jurchen Radicals is a Unicode block containing radicals used to aid in Jurchen script character lookup. They are based on Jin Qicong's Jurchen script Dictionary (女真文辞典).

Kana Extended-B.title: Kana Extended-B
Kana Extended-B.extract: Kana Extended-B is a Unicode block containing Taiwanese kana (that is, kana originally created by Japanese linguists to write Taiwanese Hokkien).

Kana Supplement.title: Kana Supplement
Kana Supplement.extract: Kana Supplement is a Unicode block containing one archaic katakana character and 255 hentaigana (non-standard Hiragana) characters. Additional hentaigana characters are encoded in the Kana Extended-A block.

Kana Extended-A.title: Kana Extended-A
Kana Extended-A.extract: Kana Extended-A is a Unicode block containing hentaigana (non-standard hiragana) and historic kana characters. Additional hentaigana characters are encoded in the Kana Supplement block.

Small Kana Extension.title: Small Kana Extension
Small Kana Extension.extract: Small Kana Extension is a Unicode block containing additional small variants for the Hiragana and Katakana syllabaries, in addition to those in the Hiragana, Katakana and Katakana Phonetic Extensions blocks.

Nushu.title: Nushu (Unicode block)
Nushu.extract: Nushu is a Unicode block containing characters from the Nüshu script, which is a syllabary derived from Chinese characters that was used exclusively among women in Jiangyong County in Hunan province of southern China.

Duployan.title: Duployan (Unicode block)
Duployan.extract: Duployan is a Unicode block containing characters for various Duployan shorthands, including French Duployéan, Chinook Writing, Romanian shorthand, and the English Sloan-Duployan, Pernin, and Perrault shorthands. It is the first block of shorthand characters included in the Unicode Standard.

Shorthand Format Controls.title: Shorthand Format Controls
Shorthand Format Controls.extract: Shorthand Format Controls is a Unicode block containing four formatting characters for representing shorthands in Unicode.

Symbols for Legacy Computing Supplement.title: Symbols for Legacy Computing Supplement
Symbols for Legacy Computing Supplement.extract: Symbols for Legacy Computing Supplement is a Unicode block containing additional graphic characters that were used for various home computers from the 1970s and 1980s, extending the set of characters provided by the Symbols for Legacy Computing block.

Miscellaneous Symbols Supplement.title: Miscellaneous Symbols Supplement
Miscellaneous Symbols Supplement.extract: Miscellaneous Symbols Supplement is a Unicode block containing a variety of symbols: astronomical symbols, geomantic figures, and one standard state chemical symbol.

Znamenny Musical Notation.title: Znamenny Musical Notation
Znamenny Musical Notation.extract: Znamenny Musical Notation is a Unicode block containing characters for Znamenny musical notation from Russia.

Byzantine Musical Symbols.title: Byzantine Musical Symbols
Byzantine Musical Symbols.extract: Byzantine Musical Symbols is a Unicode block containing characters for representing Byzantine music in ekphonetic notation.

Musical Symbols.title: Musical Symbols (Unicode block)
Musical Symbols.extract: Musical Symbols is a Unicode block containing characters for representing modern musical notation. Fonts that support it include Bravura, Euterpe, FreeSerif, Musica and Symbola. The Standard Music Font Layout (SMuFL), which is supported by the MusicXML format, expands on the Musical Symbols Unicode Block's 220 glyphs by using the Private Use Area in the Basic Multilingual Plane, permitting close to 2600 glyphs.

Ancient Greek Musical Notation.title: Ancient Greek Musical Notation
Ancient Greek Musical Notation.extract: Ancient Greek Musical Notation is a Unicode block containing symbols representing musical notations used in ancient Greece.

Kaktovik Numerals.title: Kaktovik Numerals (Unicode block)
Kaktovik Numerals.extract: The Kaktovik Numerals are a Unicode block for the Kaktovik numerals, a base-20 system of numerical digits created by Alaskan Iñupiaq. It was first encoded in Unicode version 15 in 2022. It contains 20 characters for representing each of the digits 0-19 in the base-20 place value numeral system of Iñupiaq and related Inuit, Yupik, and Unangan languages.

Mayan Numerals.title: Mayan Numerals (Unicode block)
Mayan Numerals.extract: Mayan Numerals is a Unicode block containing characters for the historical Mayan numeral system.

Counting Rod Numerals.title: Counting Rod Numerals
Counting Rod Numerals.extract: Counting Rod Numerals is a Unicode block containing traditional Chinese counting rod symbols, which mathematicians used for calculation in ancient China, Japan, Korea, and Vietnam. The orientation of the Unicode characters follows Song dynasty convention, with digits represented as horizontal lines, and tens represented as vertical lines, which differs from Han dynasty practice which represented digits as vertical lines, and tens as horizontal lines.

Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols.title: Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols
Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols.extract: Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols is a Unicode block comprising styled forms of Latin and Greek letters and decimal digits that enable mathematicians to denote different notions with different letter styles. The letters in various fonts often have specific, fixed meanings in particular areas of mathematics. By providing uniformity over numerous mathematical articles and books, these conventions help to read mathematical formulas. These also may be used to differentiate between concepts that share a letter in a single problem.

Sutton SignWriting.title: Sutton SignWriting (Unicode block)
Sutton SignWriting.extract: Sutton SignWriting is a Unicode block containing characters used in SignWriting, a system for writing sign languages that was developed by Valerie Sutton in 1974.

Latin Extended-G.title: Latin Extended-G
Latin Extended-G.extract: Latin Extended-G is a Unicode block containing additional characters, many of them for phonetic transcription.

Glagolitic Supplement.title: Glagolitic Supplement
Glagolitic Supplement.extract: Glagolitic Supplement is a Unicode block containing supplementary characters used in the Glagolitic script. It currently contains 38 combining letters.

Cyrillic Extended-D.title: Cyrillic Extended-D
Cyrillic Extended-D.extract: Cyrillic Extended-D is a Unicode block containing superscript and subscript Cyrillic characters used in Cyrillic-based phonetic transcription, as well as a combining character. The block contains the first Cyrillic characters defined outside of the Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP).

Nyiakeng Puachue Hmong.title: Nyiakeng Puachue Hmong (Unicode block)
Nyiakeng Puachue Hmong.extract: Nyiakeng Puachue Hmong is a Unicode block containing characters devised in the 1980s for writing the White Hmong and Green Hmong languages.

Toto.title: Toto (Unicode block)
Toto.extract: Toto is a Unicode block containing characters for Dhaniram Toto's script for writing the Toto language of in northeast India.

Wancho.title: Wancho (Unicode block)
Wancho.extract: Wancho is a Unicode block containing the characters of the script used to write the Wancho language.

Nag Mundari.title: Nag Mundari (Unicode block)
Nag Mundari.extract: Nag Mundari is a Unicode block containing the letters for writing the Mundari language. Nag Mundari is encoded as a unicameral alphabet. The Nag Mundari block contains 27 letters plus five diacritics and ten digits.

Ol Onal.title: Ol Onal (Unicode block)
Ol Onal.extract: Ol Onal is a Unicode block containing letters for the Ol Onal alphabet, created between 1981 and 1992 to write the Bhumij language.

Tai Yo.title: Tai Yo (Unicode block)
Tai Yo.extract: Tai Yo is a Unicode block for Lai Tay script, previously used to write the Tai Yo language in Vietnam.

Ethiopic Extended-B.title: Ethiopic Extended-B
Ethiopic Extended-B.extract: Ethiopic Extended-B is a Unicode block containing additional Geʽez characters for the Gurage languages of Ethiopia.

Mende Kikakui.title: Mende Kikakui (Unicode block)
Mende Kikakui.extract: Mende Kikakui is a Unicode block containing the Kikakui characters for writing the Mende language.

Adlam.title: Adlam (Unicode block)
Adlam.extract: Adlam is a Unicode block containing characters from the Adlam script, an alphabetic script devised during the late 1980s for writing the Fula language.

Indic Siyaq Numbers.title: Indic Siyaq Numbers
Indic Siyaq Numbers.extract: Indic Siyaq Numbers is a Unicode block containing a specialized subset of the Arabic script that was used for accounting in India under the Mughals by the 17th century through the middle of the 20th century.

Ottoman Siyaq Numbers.title: Ottoman Siyaq Numbers
Ottoman Siyaq Numbers.extract: Ottoman Siyaq Numbers is a Unicode block containing a specialized subset of the Arabic script that was used for accounting in Ottoman Turkish documents.

Arabic Mathematical Alphabetic Symbols.title: Arabic Mathematical Alphabetic Symbols
Arabic Mathematical Alphabetic Symbols.extract: Arabic Mathematical Alphabetic Symbols is a Unicode block encoding characters used in Arabic mathematical expressions.

Mahjong Tiles.title: Mahjong Tiles (Unicode block)
Mahjong Tiles.extract: Mahjong Tiles is a Unicode block containing characters depicting the standard set of tiles used in the game of Mahjong.

Domino Tiles.title: Domino Tiles
Domino Tiles.extract: Domino Tiles is a Unicode block containing characters for representing game situations in dominoes. The block includes symbols for the standard six dot tile set and backs in horizontal and vertical orientations.

Playing Cards.title: Playing Cards (Unicode block)
Playing Cards.extract: The Unicode block Playing Cards contains a full 56-card deck for the Minor Arcana (i.e., a standard 52-card deck with King, Queen, and Jack face cards plus a Knight for all four suits), three jokers, The Fool tarot card, 21 trump cards from the Tarot Nouveau, and a backside.

Enclosed Alphanumeric Supplement.title: Enclosed Alphanumeric Supplement
Enclosed Alphanumeric Supplement.extract: Enclosed Alphanumeric Supplement is a Unicode block consisting of Latin alphabet characters and Arabic numerals enclosed in circles, ovals or boxes, used for a variety of purposes. It is encoded in the range U+1F100–U+1F1FF in the Supplementary Multilingual Plane.

Enclosed Ideographic Supplement.title: Enclosed Ideographic Supplement
Enclosed Ideographic Supplement.extract: Enclosed Ideographic Supplement is a Unicode block containing forms of characters and words from Chinese, Japanese and Korean enclosed within or stylised as squares, brackets, or circles. It contains three such characters containing one or more kana, and many containing CJK ideographs. Many of its characters were added for compatibility with the Japanese ARIB STD-B24 standard. Six symbols from Chinese folk religion were added in Unicode version 10.

Miscellaneous Symbols and Pictographs.title: Miscellaneous Symbols and Pictographs
Miscellaneous Symbols and Pictographs.extract: Miscellaneous Symbols and Pictographs is a Unicode block containing meteorological and astronomical symbols, emoji characters largely for compatibility with Japanese telephone carriers' implementations of Shift JIS, and characters originally from the Wingdings and Webdings fonts found in Microsoft Windows.

Emoticons.title: Emoticons (Unicode block)
Emoticons.extract: Emoticons is a Unicode block containing emoticons or emoji.

Ornamental Dingbats.title: Ornamental Dingbats
Ornamental Dingbats.extract: Ornamental Dingbats is a Unicode block containing ornamental leaves, punctuation, and ampersands, quilt squares, and checkerboard patterns.

Transport and Map Symbols.title: Transport and Map Symbols
Transport and Map Symbols.extract: Transport and Map Symbols is a Unicode block containing transportation and map icons, largely for compatibility with Japanese telephone carriers' emoji implementations of Shift JIS and for encoding characters in the Wingdings and Wingdings 2 character sets.

Alchemical Symbols.title: Alchemical Symbols (Unicode block)
Alchemical Symbols.extract: Alchemical Symbols is a Unicode block containing symbols for chemicals and substances used in ancient and medieval alchemy texts. Many of the symbols are duplicates or redundant with previous characters.

Geometric Shapes Extended.title: Geometric Shapes Extended
Geometric Shapes Extended.extract: Geometric Shapes Extended is a Unicode block containing Webdings/Wingdings symbols, mostly different weights of squares, crosses, and saltires, and different weights of variously spoked asterisks, stars, and various color squares and circles for emoji.

Supplemental Arrows-C.title: Supplemental Arrows-C
Supplemental Arrows-C.extract: Supplemental Arrows-C is a Unicode block containing stylistic variants, weights, and fills of standard directional arrows.

Supplemental Symbols and Pictographs.title: Supplemental Symbols and Pictographs
Supplemental Symbols and Pictographs.extract: Supplemental Symbols and Pictographs is a Unicode block containing emoji characters. This block extends the set of symbols included in the Miscellaneous Symbols and Pictographs block. It also includes Typikon symbols.

Chess Symbols.title: Chess Symbols
Chess Symbols.extract: Chess Symbols is a Unicode block containing characters for fairy chess and related notations beyond the basic Western chess symbols (U+2654 to U+265F) in the Miscellaneous Symbols block, as well as symbols representing game pieces for xiangqi (Chinese chess).

Symbols and Pictographs Extended-A.title: Symbols and Pictographs Extended-A
Symbols and Pictographs Extended-A.extract: Symbols and Pictographs Extended-A is a Unicode block containing emoji characters. It extends the set of symbols included in the Supplemental Symbols and Pictographs block.

Symbols for Legacy Computing.title: Symbols for Legacy Computing
Symbols for Legacy Computing.extract: Symbols for Legacy Computing is a Unicode block containing graphic characters that were used for various home computers from the 1970s and 1980s and in teletext broadcasting standards. It includes characters from the Amstrad CPC, MSX, Mattel Aquarius, RISC OS, MouseText, Atari ST, TRS-80 Color Computer, Oric, Texas Instruments TI-99/4A, TRS-80, Minitel, Teletext, ATASCII, PETSCII, ZX80, and ZX81 character sets. Semigraphics characters are also included in the form of new block-shaped characters, line-drawing characters, and 60 "sextant" characters (semigraphic character made up of six smaller blocks, also known as alpha-mosaic characters).

CJK Unified Ideographs Extension B.title: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension B
CJK Unified Ideographs Extension B.extract: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension B is a Unicode block containing rare and historic CJK ideographs for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese submitted to the Ideographic Research Group between 1998 and 2000, plus seven gongche characters for kunqu added in Unicode 13.0, and two characters for the Macao Supplementary Character Set added in Unicode 14.0.

CJK Unified Ideographs Extension C.title: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension C
CJK Unified Ideographs Extension C.extract: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension C is a Unicode block containing rare and historic CJK ideographs for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese submitted to the Ideographic Research Group between 2002 and 2006, plus five "urgently needed" characters added in Unicode versions 14.0 and 15.0, some of which had previously been mistakenly unified with other characters.

CJK Unified Ideographs Extension D.title: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension D
CJK Unified Ideographs Extension D.extract: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension D is a Unicode block containing uncommon CJK ideographs for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese, some of which are in current use. Much smaller than most Unicode blocks for CJK unified ideographs, Extension D consists of characters which were submitted to the Ideographic Research Group as "urgently needed characters" between 2006 and 2009. Characters submitted during the same period which were needed less urgently were included in CJK Unified Ideographs Extension E instead.

CJK Unified Ideographs Extension E.title: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension E
CJK Unified Ideographs Extension E.extract: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension E is a Unicode block containing rare and historic CJK ideographs for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese submitted to the Ideographic Research Group between 2006 and 2013, excluding the characters submitted as "urgently needed" between 2006 and 2009, which were included in CJK Unified Ideographs Extension D.

CJK Unified Ideographs Extension F.title: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension F
CJK Unified Ideographs Extension F.extract: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension F is a Unicode block containing rare and historic CJK ideographs for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese, as well as more than a thousand Sawndip characters for writing the Zhuang language, which were submitted to the Ideographic Research Group between 2012 and 2015.

CJK Unified Ideographs Extension I.title: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension I
CJK Unified Ideographs Extension I.extract: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension I is a Unicode block comprising CJK Unified Ideographs included in drafts of an amendment to China's GB 18030 standard circulated in 2022 and 2023, which were fast-tracked into Unicode in 2023.

CJK Compatibility Ideographs Supplement.title: CJK Compatibility Ideographs Supplement
CJK Compatibility Ideographs Supplement.extract: CJK Compatibility Ideographs Supplement is a Unicode block containing Han characters used only for roundtrip compatibility mapping with planes 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 15 of CNS 11643-1992.

CJK Unified Ideographs Extension G.title: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension G
CJK Unified Ideographs Extension G.extract: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension G is a Unicode block containing rare and historic CJK Unified Ideographs for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese which were submitted to the Ideographic Research Group during 2015. It is the first block to be allocated to the Tertiary Ideographic Plane.

CJK Unified Ideographs Extension H.title: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension H
CJK Unified Ideographs Extension H.extract: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension H is a Unicode block containing rare and historic CJK Unified Ideographs for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Sawndip, and Vietnamese submitted to the Ideographic Research Group during 2017.

CJK Unified Ideographs Extension J.title: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension J
CJK Unified Ideographs Extension J.extract: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension J is a Unicode block containing rare and historic CJK Unified Ideographs for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese which were submitted to the Ideographic Research Group in 2021.

Seal.title: Seal (Unicode block)
Seal.extract: Seal, also called Small Seal, is a Unicode block covering the seal script character repertoire of the Han dynasty dictionary Shuowen Jiezi, i.e. small seal script, Guwen, and Zhouwen.

Tags.title: Tags (Unicode block)
Tags.extract: Tags is a Unicode block containing formatting tag characters. The block is designed to mirror ASCII. It was originally intended for language tags, but has now been repurposed as emoji modifiers, specifically for region flags.

Variation Selectors Supplement.title: Variation Selectors Supplement
Variation Selectors Supplement.description: Unicode block containing additional Variation Selectors
Variation Selectors Supplement.extract: Variation Selectors Supplement is a Unicode block containing additional variation selectors beyond those found in the Variation Selectors block.
